cds.title: Saginaw Valley State University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (XLSX)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2025), residency rows: in-state 9,532 applied / 7,650 admitted / 1,231 enrolled; out-of-state 496 / 344 / 36; international 1,558 / 1,093 / 69 (70% admitted). No waitlist, early decision or early action; no application closing date (rolling). SVSU reports test-blind admissions, so C9 SAT/ACT percentiles and percent submitting are blank and no scores are stored. Undergrad and international counts are B1/B2 'Total undergraduates' (6,280; nonresident 252). Student-faculty ratio is the Fall 2025 value from I-2 (16.3).

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8: SAT/ACT 'not considered for admission, even if submitted'; the CDS note says SVSU has moved to test-blind admissions and received scores are used for class placement.

cost.notes: CDS G1 first-year 2026-27: one flat block tuition of $14,280 is listed for every residency (it includes the Red & White Scholarship that SVSU applies to out-of-state and international students); no required fees. H6: 245 nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid (average $11,403).
